entries.title: AI collection answers must advise before reporting evidence
entries.normalized_rule: Collection-analysis answers must lead with a concise, decision-relevant point of view; prioritize the few signals that matter most; explain business implications; recommend concrete leadership action; and place retrieval coverage in a quiet footer instead of opening with process telemetry.
entries.rationale: A source-complete answer can still be unusable when it behaves like a retrieval report. Executive users need judgment, consequences, and action before provenance detail.
anti_patterns: Open with counts and processing details, then catalog generic categories using repeated sentence templates.
preferred_patterns: Lead with the most consequential evidence-backed judgment, explain why it matters, recommend a short action sequence, and close with a compact evidence-basis note.
user_quotes: Are you freaking serious? This is awful... it sounds like a robot not an executive advisor.

first_checks.command: node scripts/ops/frontend-feedback-ledger.mjs lookup --text "AI collection answers must advise before reporting evidence"
first_checks.expected: The new conversation-derived frontend rule is returned for future frontend work.

entries.title: Use short direct 'View all' CTA copy
entries.normalized_rule: For secondary see-more links, use the shortest direct CTA label possible. Do not append entity names, hidden-count phrases, or explanatory fragments when the destination already provides that context.
entries.rationale: Extra nouns and counts add noise without improving comprehension, confidence, or the next action.
user_quotes: This is way too wordy: "View all subcontractors 18 more" Change this to "View all".

first_checks.expected: Review candidate secondary CTA copy and prefer the shortest direct label.

first_checks.command: node scripts/ops/frontend-feedback-ledger.mjs lookup --text "view all too wordy" --files frontend/src/app/(main)/[projectId]/home/project-command-center.tsx
first_checks.expected: This rule should be returned for frontend copy review on the project home route.

incidents.summary: User flagged the project-home CTA copy as too wordy and asked for the shorter canonical label.
